name: FaunaDB
description_en:
FaunaDB is a product in the Database management category. Its directory profile covers Virtualization, Relational Interface, Queries, Performance Analysis, Monitoring, Database Conversion, Data Search, Data Replication.

Additional listed capabilities include Data Migration, Creation (Development), Backup. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $22.50. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: move supported records between systems; create additional copies of selected data. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
FaunaDB 属于数据库管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括虚拟化、关系型数据界面、查询、性能分析、监控、数据库转换、数据搜索、数据复制。

资料还列出数据迁移、创建与开发、数据备份。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $22.50. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在系统之间迁移受支持的记录；为选定数据创建额外副本。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official homepage timed out; official end-of-life FAQ, announcement and status originals were inaccessible through the reader. Ordinary public HTTP requests to homepage/FAQ/announcement also failed with TLS timeout or closed connection; no TLS bypass. Official search snippets describe May30,2025 end-of-service, but snippets are discovery only and are not adopted as a completed primary-source read. Current availability, operational documentation, fees, data recovery and any actual open-source release/license remain unverified. Not complete.
